overview_description.description: GERIFIN Corporation is a Middle Eastern brand in the design, marketing, and distribution of luxury lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, footwear and accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 20 years, GERIFIN has sought to inspire the dream of a better life through authenticity and timeless style.
